# Project Status

## Authority

State that this document owns current project state, not scope or history.

## Current state

Summarize the accepted `development` state needed to understand current delivery.

## Active goal

Identify the current top-level Product Goal or single-level Goal and its status.

## In progress

List only currently active executable work that materially affects the active Goal.

## Current gaps

List only gaps relevant to current planning/readiness. Do not retain a permanent backlog here.

## Next action

State the single next coherent action or gate.
